checks.outcome: Checked only the final valuation-ring restriction claim. If V is a valuation ring of L and L1 is a subfield, then for every nonzero a in L1, either a or a⁻¹ lies in V, hence in V∩L1. This also represents every a in L1 as a quotient of elements of V∩L1, so its fraction field is L1. Thus V∩L1 is a valuation ring of L1. This does not establish nontriviality, rank, or any assertion about germs of sections.
